title: Mayor Bass, Councilmember Jurado & Supervisor Solis Attend Boyle Heights/East LA Town Hall (7/9/26)
description:
Mayor Bass joins Councilmember Ysabel Jurado, Supervisor Hilda Solis, and Lineage leadership at a town hall to hear directly from residents in accordance with Mayor Bass' Emergency Executive Orders issued on June 29.
